statement: The function returns a result r and len(r) = n. For every i with 0 <= i < n, let M_i = max(nums[0], nums[1], ..., nums[i]); then r[i] = sum_{k=0}^{i} (nums[k] + M_k). In words, r[i] is the score of the prefix nums[0..i]: the sum over k <= i of nums[k] plus the maximum of nums[0..k].
preconditions: n = len(nums); 1 <= n <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: The function returns a result r; it does not fail with overflow, out-of-bounds, or panic on any input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: n = len(nums); 1 <= n <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every i with 0 <= i < n, r[i] >= 2 * sum_{k=0}^{i} nums[k].
preconditions: n = len(nums); 1 <= n <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every i with 0 <= i < n, letting M_i = max(nums[0], ..., nums[i]), r[i] <= 2 * (i + 1) * M_i.
preconditions: n = len(nums); 1 <= n <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every i with 1 <= i < n, letting M_i = max(nums[0], ..., nums[i]), r[i] = r[i-1] + nums[i] + M_i.
preconditions: n = len(nums); 1 <= n <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every i with 1 <= i < n, r[i] >= r[i-1] + 2.
preconditions: n = len(nums); 1 <= n <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r and nums is nondecreasing (nums[j-1] <= nums[j] for every 1 <= j < n), for every i with 0 <= i < n, r[i] = 2 * sum_{k=0}^{i} nums[k].
preconditions: n = len(nums); 1 <= n <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every i with 0 <= i < n, if nums[0] is a maximum of the prefix nums[0..i] (that is, nums[j] <= nums[0] for every 0 <= j <= i), then r[i] = (i + 1) * nums[0] + sum_{k=0}^{i} nums[k].
preconditions: n = len(nums); 1 <= n <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: For every i with 0 <= i < n and every array nums2 of length n2 with i < n2 <= 100000 and 1 <= nums2[j] <= 1000000000 for all 0 <= j < n2, if nums2[j] = nums[j] for every 0 <= j <= i, then whenever the call on nums returns r and the call on nums2 returns r2, r[i] = r2[i].
preconditions: n = len(nums); 1 <= n <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every i with 0 <= i < n there exist indices p_0, p_1, ..., p_i such that 0 <= p_k <= k for every 0 <= k <= i, nums[p_k] = max(nums[0], ..., nums[k]), and r[i] = sum_{k=0}^{i} (nums[k] + nums[p_k]).
preconditions: n = len(nums); 1 <= n <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.
